g.text: 2-channel E-stop input with cross-fault detection · monitored manual reset at S33-S34 (acts on release)
24 V DC · outputs 3 NO (13-14, 23-24, 33-34) + 1 NC (41-42) · device rated for Cat. 3 / PL d (ISO 13849-1)
must be closed for a reset (welded-
Stop category 0 (IEC 60204-1 §9.2.2): -K0 removes 24V-S, so every contactor coil and solenoid valve on 24V-S de-energises directly, whatever the PLC outputs are: pumps, fans and
drives stop, valves close by spring.
-S0.1 (door) and -S0.2 (fertigation skid) are in series in both channels; each has 2 NC contacts with positive opening (IEC 60947-5-5), latching, red mushroom on yellow ground.
-S0R (blue): monitored manual reset, effective on release, only with the EDM loop closed.
-K0 33-34 signals ESTOP_OK to the PLC (/E-07.3): monitoring only. After a reset the PLC still needs RESET (A00) and START: no automatic restart.
* PLr to be confirmed by the risk assessment (ISO 12100 / ISO 13849-1). Pressure protection, dry-run protection and the vent/fan interlock are PLC functions (FDS §11), not safety
Irrigation, fertigation and climate control, 1 000 m² greenhouse
OpenPLC Runtime v4 + Modbus TCP remote I/O
Electrical drawing set - control panel GH-1 (pump room)
